# Vendored packages

`rozenite-ui-1.7.0.tgz` is built from `packages/ui` at Rozenite commit
`4e1c3bd` (MIT). Rozenite's plugins use this package, but `@rozenite/ui` 1.7.0 is
not currently available from the npm registry. The tarball can be replaced with
the registry dependency once it is published.
